faq.question: What usually works best at pickup counters?
faq.answer: The best format depends on how brief the pickup moment is and whether staff has enough time to point out the prompt or whether it must work as a visible self-serve cue.

faq.question: Why should pickup counters test format before scaling?
faq.answer: Because queue speed, handoff pressure and customer attention at pickup often behave very differently from a normal checkout or seated service environment.
